verdict.rationale: The evidence only hints at API versioning. There are SDK release notes, versioned-path reference docs under /sdk/py/latest/, and stability labels such as Beta, Alpha and an _experimental_ prefix, which together suggest a versioned SDK with maturity tiers. Nothing in the pack describes a deprecation policy, deprecation timelines, or a versioned HTTP API, and no OpenAPI spec was found. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation policy, explicit API/SDK versioning guarantees (e.g. semver or support windows), a versioned public API spec, and independent corroboration.
